summary: Thomson Reuters filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing the pricing of a debt offering: US$1.3bn of US notes via subsidiary TR Finance LLC (US$800m 5.100% due 2028; US$500m 5.750% due 2033) and C$1.0bn of Canadian private placement notes by TRC (C$350m 4.130% due 2029; C$350m 4.480% due 2031; C$300m CORRA+0.76% float due 2029). Both close September 17, 2026; net proceeds about US$1.295bn and C$997m fund general corporate purposes and commercial paper repayment. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
